description: This file is a shell script for testing the 'git clean' command under various scenarios. It defines numerous test cases, sets up test repositories, and verifies the behavior of 'git clean' with different options, pathspecs, and configurations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to succeed, executes the supplied commands, and verifies success.

methods.name: test_expect_failure
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to fail, executes the commands, and checks for failure.

methods.name: test_expect_success POSIXPERM,SANITY
methods.description: A variant of 'test_expect_success' with specific tags, such as POSIX permissions or SANITY checks.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new git repository as part of the test setup.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that the previous command failed.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that a directory or file is empty.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Asserts that the specified path exists and is a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks that the specified path does not exist.

methods.name: test_path_exists
methods.description: Verifies that the specified path exists (file or directory).

methods.name: test_path_is_dir
methods.description: Asserts that the specified directory exists.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in a command output or file.

methods.name: test_config_global
methods.description: Sets local or global git configuration parameters for testing.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files or directories.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after the test.
